text:
tess-platform: thinking about adding a per-route reservoir sampler + tail-sampling toggle in Console. want UX + API input before i draft PR. key goals: keep stable cost, surface retention impact, enable deterministic reproduction for evals. thoughts?

liam-sre: +1 on tooling but concerned about exporter backpressure. if reservoir holds onto more spans we might hit OTLP exporter queues. need queue metrics and clear backoff behavior. fyi we recently saw `exporter_queue_ms` spike in staging.

anya-ml: agree with liam. also: reservoir should be sequence-length aware — weight by span/token length so long sessions get proportional chance in tail. and we should support a `deterministic_seed` per-tenant for reproducible sampling during evals. prototype config below: 

```yaml
sampler_policy: 
  strategy: headtail
  head_rate: 0.02
  tail:
    reservoir_size: 200
    weight_by_length: true
    decay_window_ms: 300000
  deterministic_seed: 42
  route_matchers: ["/api/generate/*", "/internal/route/*"]
```

sam-eng: API suggestion: expose a single `SamplerPolicy` resource (`/v1/samplers`) that supports `strategy: reservoir|headtail|probabilistic`, `reservoir_size`, `decay_window_ms`, `deterministic_seed`, and `route_matchers`. responses should include estimated sample rate and estimated retained bytes per hour. example payload: 

```json
{ "strategy": "reservoir", "reservoir_size": 100, "route_matchers": ["/v1/rl/*"] }
```

maria-frontend: UX thoughts: show an "estimated retention delta" card and an estimated monthly token/storage cost (based on historical traffic for selected routes). add a "simulate" toggle that runs the sampler heuristics against 1h of past traces and shows what WOULD be sampled. customers love previews.

liam-sre: also recommend a fail-safe: if exporter lag > 2s or queue length > N, automatically switch to a temporary probabilistic fallback (e.g., 0.1%) to prevent OOMs. surface metrics: `exporter_queue_ms`, `exporter_dropped_spans_total`, `sampler_simulated_rate`.

tess-platform: OK — rollout UX: default policy OFF. enable per-tenant canary with route filtering. have a "preview/simulate" mode as maria suggested. we should also expose a small audit log of sampler decisions for a limited retention so customers can debug.

anya-ml: simulate + deterministic seed = we can run offline A/B tests (run same seed across weeks). also want an exportable sample of retained traces for human review. :100:

sam-eng: i'll sketch the proto and add a console card that shows expected budget + sparkline. will include an admin API to toggle simulate vs enforce. draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/internal/pull/4821 (WIP).

devops-bot: deploy/telemetry-sampler-config updated in staging at 2039876598 — job #8764 succeeded.

tess-platform: thanks all. action items: sam -> API proto + admin endpoints, maria -> UX mock + simulate UI, liam -> fail-safe thresholds + exporter metrics, anya -> weighting function pseudo-code and export sample plan. i'll assemble a short proposal doc after mocks are in. :memo:
